internal_linking.method: Fetched /articles?page=1..12 and /articles?category=<each of the 4 categories>&page=1..6 from the origin with cache disabled, collected every <a href> matching /articles/<slug>, and compared the union against the 70 article URLs in sitemap.xml.

internal_linking.verdict: The /articles hub was rebuilt between the 28 Aug and 29 Aug scans: it now paginates 7 articles per page across 6 pages and adds four category filters. The unfiltered hub therefore exposes only 35 of the 70 articles in the sitemap. Adding every article reachable through all four category filters raises the total to 61, which still leaves 9 articles reachable from NO hub route at all. Those 9 all return 200 and are all in the sitemap, so they are not broken - they are orphaned from the site's own navigation, which removes their internal-link support. Five of the nine are the VR cluster and two are Melbourne builder pages, i.e. exactly the commercial pages the account is trying to rank. This is the most important negative finding of today's scan. / Hub /articles da duoc dung lai giua lan quet 28/08 va 29/08: nay phan trang 7 bai moi trang qua 6 trang va them 4 bo loc chuyen muc. Hub khong loc chi lo ra 35 trong 70 bai. Cong het bon chuyen muc duoc 61, van con 9 bai KHONG the toi tu bat ky duong nao tren hub. Ca 9 deu tra 200 va deu co trong sitemap nen khong hong - chung bi mo coi khoi dieu huong cua chinh site, mat toan bo ho tro lien ket noi bo. Nam trong chin la cum VR va hai la trang builder Melbourne - dung nhung trang thuong mai dang can len hang. Day la phat hien tieu cuc quan trong nhat hom nay.
internal_linking.recommended_action: Either raise the hub page size so all 70 articles are reachable without filters, or add an explicit 'all articles' index route, or at minimum ensure every article belongs to at least one category. Until then 9 commercial pages have no internal links pointing at them. / Hoac tang so bai moi trang, hoac them mot trang chi muc 'tat ca bai viet', hoac it nhat gan moi bai vao mot chuyen muc.
